description: This file defines a web search provider plugin for xAI within the openclaw framework, including setup functions, cache management, credential handling, and tool creation for web search with xAI.

methods.name: resolveXSearchConfigRecord
methods.description: Resolves the effective xSearch configuration from the provided context.

methods.name: runXaiSearchProviderSetup
methods.description: Handles the setup process for the xAI web search provider, including enabling and model selection.

methods.name: runXaiWebSearch
methods.description: Performs a web search using xAI, with caching based on query and model.

methods.name: resolveXaiToolSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the search configuration for the xAI web search tool.

methods.name: resolveXaiWebSearchCredential
methods.description: Retrieves the API key credential for xAI web search.

methods.name: createXaiWebSearchProvider
methods.description: Creates the web search provider plugin object for xAI, including setup, credential management, and tool creation.
